messages.author: 31dc03607958a62a
messages.subject: Manual page 204 log Uniform(s|1,T)
parts:
All stan's users,

In the manual, it was written for transforming log uniform(s|1,T)  as below :

log_unif = -log(T)

I can understand if T is very large.
However, is it the same if T is less than 15 ?  For me, log_unif = - log(T-1) 

In my simulation, T can be very small, T can be 2,3....and 15.

Bests regards.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Manual page 204 log Uniform(s|1,T)
parts:
Because

uniform(y | a, b) = 1 / (b - a)

so

log uniform(y | a, b) = -log(b - a)

so

log uniform(y | 0, T) = -log(T)

Doesn't matter how small (b - a) is.

- Bob
